purpose: Integration fixes discovered while merging origin/main f8f0f292 into browser after 45826e3c. Not browser speed or website acceptance evidence.
method: Release binaries, owned headless 1920x1080 session, DPR1 at60Hz, 20 window resizes alternating outer690x400 and690x611, x49 y40. First draw ready ends at GPU submission, not presentation. tools/dev/cost records a two-second idle interval. Passwords setup uses an empty private vault. Disk Usage scans the same scratch home, whose cache file counts can vary between launches.
caveats: The initial resize runs overlapped compilation; the quiet runs were after it finished. All initial measurements are retained below.
Passwords after has four cursor-blink frames in the initial idle interval; a separate explicitly unfocused measurement is recorded.
No inference of a statistically established speedup.

import json,socket,sys,time,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
pid=int(sys.argv[1]);out=Path(sys.argv[2]);env=json.loads(Path('/var/tmp/olo-dev/codex-browser-integration/env.json').read_text())
def ask(path,r):
 with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as s:
  s.settimeout(5);s.connect(path);s.sendall((json.dumps(r)+'\n').encode());return json.loads(s.makefile().readline())
sock=f'/run/user/1000/olo-menus-{pid}.sock'
w=next(w for w in ask(env['OLO_SOCKET'],{'type':'list_windows'})['windows'] if w.get('pid')==pid)
rows=[]
for h in [400,611]*10:
 ask(sock,{'frames':True});t=time.monotonic_ns()/1000
 ask(env['OLO_SOCKET'],{'type':'place','id':w['id'],'frame':{'x':49,'y':40,'width':690,'height':h}})
 marks=[]
 for _ in range(100):
  for f in ask(sock,{'frames':True}):marks.extend(m for m in f.get('marks',[]) if m['at_us']>=t)
  if marks:break
  time.sleep(.005)
 rows.append({'height':h,'first_draw_ready_ms':(marks[0]['at_us']+marks[0]['us']-t)/1000 if marks else None,'marks':marks})
 time.sleep(.05)
idle=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/python3','tools/dev/cost',str(pid),'2','--json']))
result={'resize':rows,'idle':idle};out.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print('median first draw ready ms',statistics.median(r['first_draw_ready_ms'] for r in rows if r['first_draw_ready_ms'] is not None),'max draw us',max(m['us'] for r in rows for m in r['marks']),'idle',idle['total'])
